notes: Chunk B: modules M2 (from Questions: Counting with Place Value) and M4; 28 units = 22 pairs and 6 worked examples.
Only one real figure in this chunk: Puzzle time (M2.S15.T15.C88 / C89), five place boxes tth, th, h, t, u; the solution fills them with 1, 2, 4, 2, 1.

M2.S15.T15.C88 question_tex has no clues. The four clues (5-digit palindrome, odd, t digit double the u digit, h digit double the t digit) are only in the old q_figure hint; the question text must carry them, otherwise the box labels have no meaning. Flagged with needs_lp_text_sync.

Six worked examples reuse existing concept images of their own topic (C81.IMG1 for the four reverse-and-add examples, C93.IMG1 and C93.IMG2 for the date and calendar examples); no new image is added for them.

Several question/solution items sit in a later 'Questions' topic than the lesson image that already draws the same thing (Counting with Place Value, Clock and Calendar, Simple Estimation, Games and Winning Strategies). Reuse is only allowed inside one topic, so these are 'none' (text/LaTeX); they are not near-copies to add.

M4.S34.T34.C198/C199 (Roshan's custard): the LP solution disagrees with the printed book answer (LP: do not agree, about 165 rupees; book: yes it is possible with small servings and one cheap fruit of each type). LP followed.
M4.S33.T33.C193 (litres): the LP takes a mug as about 1 litre (like a big bottle); an ordinary mug holds about a quarter of a litre. Not a diagram matter, left to the content reviewer.
